description: The file defines an immutable class `ImmutableJsonPatch` implementing the `JsonPatch` interface. It handles creation, parsing, and serialization of JSON Patch objects, including operations, paths, and optional values. The class includes methods for instantiation, JSON parsing, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonPatch
classes.description: Immutable class representing a JSON Patch operation with creation, parsing, and serialization capabilities.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonPatch with specified operation, path, and optional value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into an ImmutableJsonPatch object.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer specifying the path.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the value to be used for the operation.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the patch object back to a JsonObject.
